name: mirage
text: Got all 5 points; logged as DG5. Honest scope: this is a multi-step rebuild, not one release, and I won't promise a same-hour ship. Order: (1) the engine reads Novig's full fill, order and ledger history (as far back as it goes) into a permanent file on GitHub, and I check the real settlement rows against your Tracker totals; (2) the Tracker switches to read that file, same screens and charts, cached on the phone, refresh fetching only newer data; (3) CLV/EV stays as its own file on GitHub, hand-bet details are sent up at bet time; (4) only then erase the phone's old tracker data. I'll hold the erase until the new numbers show, otherwise your Tracker would be empty if Novig's history is shallower than expected. I'll tell you here when each step ships.
